pt.name: Power Thesaurus
pt.stack: React, React Native, Plasmo, custom UI library
pt.description:
Power Thesaurus is the largest crowdsourced English thesaurus with an audience of over 5 million users per month. The product has been in production for 10 years and continues to actively evolve.

The platform includes a web version, native mobile applications for Android and iOS, as well as browser extensions for all popular browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge). The modern technology stack allows maintaining a unified codebase across different platforms while ensuring high performance.
pt.role: Over 1.5 years with the team, I participated in all key company projects. Developed new features for the React web application, contributed to the React Native mobile apps, created and maintained browser extensions built on Plasmo. Made significant contributions to the internal UI component library. Optimized application performance, accelerating load times by 35%. Developed an AI module for content generation and enhancement. Worked in close collaboration with an international team.

index.role: Frontend developer in the agency's product team. Collaborated with colleagues to build admin panels, client interfaces, and landing pages. sagama.name: Sagama Group
sagama.description:
A group of companies — the largest manufacturer of rubber coverings and artificial turf for sports facilities in Russia. Over 43,500 equipped venues across the country.

The project portfolio includes corporate websites for manufacturers (SagamaGroup, EcoStep), the B2B/B2C marketplace Crumbex, as well as a series of promo landing pages for individual product lines and marketing campaigns.
sagama.role: The sole IT specialist in the staff. Independently maintained and developed 5+ websites on Php and Bitrix24, as well as WordPress. Created promo landing pages for marketing campaigns. Integrated websites with CRM, analytics services, and external APIs. Handled a wide range of tasks: from layout and minor improvements to implementing new features.
